findings.evidence: <body id="body">; 2 focusable element(s) precede the first heading
findings.violation: The page provides neither a main landmark (a <main> element or role="main") nor a leading same-page skip link.
findings.fix: Add a <main> element wrapping the primary content, or a skip link as the first focusable element linking to it.

findings.violation: The page has no usable title: the title element is missing or empty.
findings.fix: Give the page a specific <title> describing its topic or purpose.

findings.violation: The <html> element's lang attribute 'translanguage' is not a well-formed BCP 47 language tag.
findings.fix: Set lang to a well-formed BCP 47 tag identifying the page's default language, for example lang="en".

findings.evidence: Header navigation offers links to "Plan a trip" and "Accessibility"; footer offers links to privacy and terms. No site search, sitemap, breadcrumb trail, or other independent navigation mechanisms.
findings.violation: The page exposes only one primary navigation mechanism. A reader landing on this page directly has only one way to navigate to related pages.
findings.fix: Add a second independent navigation mechanism, such as a breadcrumb trail, site search, or sitemap link.

findings.violation: No text alternative is present and the element is not marked decorative.
findings.fix: Add an alt attribute (or aria-label) describing the image, or mark it decorative with alt="".

findings.violation: Heading level skips from <h2> to <h4> with no intervening level.
findings.fix: Change this heading to <h5>, or add the missing intervening heading level.

findings.violation: The link's accessible name is a generic phrase that gives no clue to its destination out of context.
findings.fix: Rewrite the link text to describe its destination or purpose, or add an aria-label.

findings.evidence: visible text 'Submit', accessible name 'Send form now'
findings.violation: The control's visible text does not appear within its accessible name, so a voice-control user naming the visible label cannot activate it.
findings.fix: Include the visible label text at the start of the aria-label value, or remove the aria-label and rely on the visible text.

findings.evidence: Input id="promo" marked aria-invalid="true"; error text in span below reads "Enter a 6 character code using letters and numbers only." No aria-describedby or aria-errormessage attribute linking the error text to the field.
findings.violation: Error text is present but not programmatically associated with the invalid input field, and reads as a format instruction rather than describing the specific error.
findings.fix: Add aria-describedby="s3-form-promo-error" to the input element to programmatically associate the error message, and ensure the error text describes what is currently wrong, not just the format requirement.
